features.title: Body and spirit
features.text: Fast movement, strong defenses and unarmed techniques support agile combat. Stances and optional qi spells let you emphasize striking, protection or control.

features.title: Flurry of Blows
features.text: Make two strikes with one action, leaving time to move, defend or attempt a maneuver. Positioning and technique matter as much as the number of attacks.

review.notes: Editorial assessment of the class framework and ordinary builds. Rules references support mechanics; scores remain judgments.

ratings.offense: 3.5 → 3–4. Stance and feat choices change damage; Flurry frees actions for other contributions.
ratings.defense: 4.5 → 4–5. Excellent saves and unarmored defense support exceptional resilience.
ratings.support: 3 → 2.5–4. Grappling, trips and mobility enable control builds; qi choices can add further help.
ratings.utility: 2 → 2–3. Mobility and physical skills help exploration; optional qi expands selected capabilities.
ratings.difficulty: 2 → 2.5. Flurry is simple, while stance requirements and maneuver choices add tactical depth.
